risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed, which affects comparables and price tier.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand logo and model number plate, usually above or below the keys.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded 61-key keyboard, not as a Yamaha model

risks.risk: Functionality (power-on, sound output, key responsiveness) is unverified.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the keyboard powering on and playing a few notes across the keyboard range.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working/for-parts condition

risks.risk: Missing power adapter/stand, which are often needed for use and add to cost.
risks.proof: Photo showing the power adapter and/or stand included with the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as keyboard-only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Physical condition under the plastic wrap (scratches, cracked keys, screen damage) cannot be assessed.
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up photos of the full keyboard body, screen, and key surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst-case cosmetic condition (heavily used/damaged)

proof_requests: Clear close-up of brand name and model number on the keyboard body.
Video of the keyboard powering on and producing sound.
Photo of included accessories (power adapter, stand, sustain pedal if any).
Unwrapped photos showing the full condition of the keys and screen.
reading.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 61-key electronic keyboard by type, but brand, functionality, and completeness are unverified, so it must be priced at worst-case condition pending proof.

why: no comparable adverts with a source and a date for this identity
